bioParagraphs: Dr. (Commerce) Timotius Tumbur Simbolon, SH., MH., we may call “Timoti Sim”.

Before establishing the Firm, the Founder served as Head of Legal at a world-renowned multinational corporation majority-owned by a Swiss company. For 5 years, he was entrusted as Head of Legal at the Indonesia-China Business Council (ICBC), an association of Indonesian entrepreneurs conducting business and investment with Chinese entrepreneurs and the Government of China.

The Founder possesses extensive expertise in Banking, National and International Arbitration, and specifically in National and International Bankruptcy (Cross-Border Insolvency-Model Law), as Curator/Receiver and Member of INSOL International - a distinction held by few in Indonesia - this aligns with his Doctoral Thesis: "Balance of Creditors' Rights in Bankruptcy," with comparative studies in numerous advanced jurisdictions.
As Legal Consultant, the Founder delivers best advice - "accurate and robust" - protecting legal interests and ensuring business continuity and future success.

Should disputes arise from agreements, the Firm "with its extensive skill and experience" invariably prevails even in fiercest battles, through “fair trial”, the Firm wins narrowly on points of law, but massively in financial value because the underlying agreement was well-protected.
